data.gender_notes: Khaila is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kh-l-l', meaning 'to be strong' or 'to be elegant'. In Islamic tradition, Khaila symbolizes the strength and grace of a woman. The name Khaila carries the meaning “Strong, Elegant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khaila usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, elegant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
